lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_flow changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect was seen for adoption and redesign changes across 2 tests, as neither showed a significant win.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results across all tests.

candidates.title: Story Card Split Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen into a split layout showcasing the companion visual preview on one side and key feature highlights on the other.
candidates.why: The choose_path drop-off is 23.8% with a long mean time of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Select a pre-made pet or create a custom friend to keep you company on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen layout while preserving its core function of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Redesign changes showed no positive effect (-0.1%) in prior tests and lack support mail evidence.

candidates.title: Existing Account Email Reminder Hint
candidates.change: Add a clear explanatory hint under the sign-in options reminding users to sign in with their existing account to restore saved pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in with different credentials.

sign_in.hint: Use the email from your existing account to instantly restore your saved pets and progress.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Pick Friend Grid Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection component in pick_friend into a structured visual grid layout.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion drops to 60.9% and takes a mean of 1017s; a clear visual grid reduces choice friction.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Photo Processing Status Hint
candidates.change: Display status hint text and dynamic progress indicators on the photo upload screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: Support noted 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or output looking incorrect during photo processing.

upload_photos.hint: Processing high-resolution photo... Ensuring pet features are generated accurately.

guard.reason: Adds photo processing status hint and dynamic progress indicator on upload_photos screen.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step supported by 3 support emails; progress indicators add low-risk clarity.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Alert Sound
candidates.change: Trigger a notification chime sound on the waiting screen once desktop initialization completes.
candidates.why: Home step median time is 201s (mean 2336s), and users reported pets failing to appear when app finishes loading quietly.

guard.reason: Triggers sound notification chime on waiting screen when pet generation finishes.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long background wait time with simple audio feedback, backed by user feedback.

candidates.title: Desktop Shortcut Controls Overview Screen
candidates.change: Add a new sub-flow screen 'new_controls_overview' before home intro introducing essential keyboard shortcuts and desktop visibility controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.

new_controls_overview.headline: Mastering Your Desktop Pet
new_controls_overview.body: Learn simple shortcuts to summon, minimize, or interact with your pet anytime on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new controls overview sub-flow screen before home_intro without removing existing steps.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off and support mail support this, but previous new_flow test yielded -1.7%.

candidates.title: Story Screen Immediate Path Highlight Reorder
candidates.change: Add direct choice components to the story screen to fast-track path selection.
candidates.why: Streamlining initial screens targets the high drop-off rate (23.8%) and long mean time (514s) in choose_path.

guard.reason: Adding direct path selection to the story screen fast-tracks selection and makes the choose_path step skippable.

candidates.title: Onboarding Celebration Reward Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new celebratory screen 'new_completion_reward' at the end of onboarding to confirm setup is complete.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% with high drop-off; a clear completion signal reassures users.

new_completion_reward.headline: Your Companion is Ready!
new_completion_reward.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop. Enjoy your new companion!

guard.reason: Adds a valid new completion reward screen after home_intro within onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: High step impact but requires a new screen, lacking explicit support mail evidence.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Mascot Badge
candidates.change: Add a celebratory mascot badge element to the adoption certificate screen to increase emotional attachment.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%); visual reinforcement boosts motivation to finish pet setup.

guard.reason: Replaces adoption certificate components with a mascot badge, removing the required official stamp.

candidates.title: Sign-In Value Proposition Copy Update
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize cross-device cloud sync and pet data security.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and multiple users were confused about lost pets when switching devices.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet Cloud Save
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet settings, customizations, and progress safe across all your computers.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to highlight cloud save functionality without violating pricing or data rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from funnel and user complaints with zero code cost copy update.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect was seen for adoption and redesign changes across 2 tests, as neither showed a significant win.
Finish and new_flow changes hurt performance across 2 tests, leading to negative effects and one test being stopped early.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results across all tests.
